title: object-detection message
description: Boxes with a caption, each in its class color. Version 1 of the contract in docs/contracts.md.

objects.description: Every detection of the frame. An empty list clears the boxes of the frame before.

bbox.description: The box. With oriented_bbox, the upright extent of the rotated box: it still places the caption and drives the region-of-interest filter.

confidence.description: Compared with the viewer's confidence threshold; a detection without one always passes.

oriented_bbox.description: A rotated box [cx, cy, width, height, angle]: its center and size in video pixels, and its rotation in radians, a positive angle turning it clockwise on screen. Planned: today's viewer draws bbox instead.
